_notes.billing: New (post 1 March 2026) evaluations are a one-time fee for 30 calendar days of access, not a subscription, no resets and no refunds. After passing, a separate one-time, non-refundable PA (Performance Account) activation fee must be paid within 7 calendar days. 'No Activation Fee' versions of every Intraday and EOD evaluation (25K-150K) cost more up front but have a $0 PA fee; 5-pack bundles also exist. Level 1 data included. A site-wide coupon (code SAVENOW, 'up to 90% off') was shown on the site; coupons do not apply to PA activation fees.
_notes.archived_price_reference: NOT for publishing - unverified. The homepage product selector data captured 2026-08-08 listed one-time evaluation prices (USD) of: EOD 25K 390 / 50K 490 / 100K 790 / 150K 1490; Intraday 25K 167 / 50K 249 / 100K 399 / 150K 599; PA activation fees EOD 99/129/139/159, Intraday 69/79/99/129. These are almost 2 months old and need confirming from a live screenshot.
_notes.rules_detail: Evaluations: no minimum trading days, no consistency rule, fixed contracts, 30-day access. EOD tier has a daily loss limit that pauses trading for the session (does not fail the account). Intraday tier has no daily loss limit (daily_loss null = none). consistency_pct 50 is the Performance Account payout rule (largest day must be under 50% of profit since last payout), not an evaluation rule. Payouts: 100% payout split, minimum 5 qualifying trading days, $500 minimum payout, maximum 6 payouts per PA then the PA closes.
_notes.payout_caps: Intraday PA maximum per payout request (payouts 1-6): 25K $1,000 each; 50K $1,500/$2,000/$2,500/$2,500/$3,000/$3,000; 100K $2,000/$2,500/$3,000/$3,000/$4,000/$4,000; 150K $2,500/$3,000/$3,000/$4,000/$4,000/$5,000. EOD PA payout page not readable - payout_cap left null for both tiers because the cap changes per payout.
_notes.legacy_products: Apex also re-offered 'Legacy' monthly-subscription evaluations for a limited time (25K-300K, e.g. 25K $167/month, plus $125 one-time PA fee; captured 2026-07-26). Not listed here because it is a limited-time offer and current availability is unconfirmed.
_notes.eligibility: Official footer says 'Services are intended for U.S. users only', while the restricted-countries page says traders from 100+ countries can join (UAE not on the restricted list captured 2026-06-30; Saudi Arabia and Pakistan are).

firm.name: Apex Trader Funding
firm.name_note: Apex Trader Funding (apextraderfunding.com), based in Austin, Texas. Not related to similarly named sites such as apexfundtraders.com.
firm.about: Apex Trader Funding is a futures-only firm that sells simulated evaluation accounts from $25K to $150K, with a choice of end-of-day or intraday trailing drawdown. Traders who pass pay an activation fee to move to a simulated funded Performance Account.

countries.notes: Apex's pages disagree: its Terms of Use say services are intended for U.S. users only, while its help-centre 'Restricted Countries' page says traders from over 100 countries can take part and lists only these 87 places as unable to buy new or additional accounts. The list includes territories (Réunion, New Caledonia, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Jersey, Western Sahara, Palestine). Kosovo is recorded as XK (a widely used code, not an official ISO one). Exception: someone originally from a restricted country may qualify if they hold a valid government ID from a non-restricted country and their home, mailing address and bank account are all in a non-restricted country; while physically in a restricted country they cannot buy accounts or request payouts. Canadians are accepted. The live site blocks automated checks, so this was read from Internet Archive copies of the official page (latest dated June 2026).
